harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created a local root CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (4096-bit RSA key, self-signed X.509 cert with CA:TRUE, 10-year validity), installed it into the system trust store via /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors and update-ca-trust extract, and verified it is trusted both by `trust list`/`openssl verify` and functionally via an end-to-end TLS handshake with a leaf certificate signed by the CA. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol: captured baseline boot ID and trust state, restarted node1 with systemctl reboot, confirmed the boot ID changed, and re-verified the CA trust anchor and full TLS trust chain post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (CentOS Stream 10) and confirmed openssl/update-ca-trust tooling available
Generated 4096-bit RSA CA private key at /root/ca/private/ca.key.pem (chmod 400)
Created self-signed root CA certificate with CN="OS Comparison Root CA", O="OS Comparison", CA:TRUE, keyCertSign/cRLSign usage, 10-year validity at /root/ca/certs/ca.cert.pem
Verified certificate subject/issuer/extensions with openssl x509
Copied CA cert to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.pem and ran update-ca-trust extract
Verified trust anchor registration via trust list and openssl verify, and presence in /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt

Issued a leaf certificate signed by the new CA, served it over TLS with openssl s_server, and confirmed curl (using default system CA bundle, no -k) validated the chain with 'SSL certificate verify ok'
Cleaned up test TLS server processes and temp files
Captured baseline boot ID (d4784d1b-162e-4faa-b581-f6427617d23c) and trust anchor state on node1
Issued systemctl reboot on node1 with acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec availability returned; confirmed new boot ID (45f1469e-e936-4160-9ce5-2ee5d3f06fb3), proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified CA trust anchor presence and full TLS trust chain post-restart

evidence.requirement: Local CA 'OS Comparison Root CA' created on node1
evidence.summary: Generated CA private key and self-signed cert with CN=OS Comparison Root CA, CA:TRUE, verified subject/issuer/extensions

evidence.requirement: CA certificate installed as trusted system CA
evidence.summary: Copied cert to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors, ran update-ca-trust extract, confirmed via trust list (trust: anchor), openssl verify OK, and presence in ca-bundle.crt

evidence.requirement: Functional proof CA is trusted for TLS validation (pre-restart)
evidence.summary: Issued leaf cert signed by CA, served via TLS, curl with system trust store validated chain: 'SSL certificate verify ok'
Captured baseline boot ID d4784d1b-162e-4faa-b581-f6427617d23c and confirmed CA trust anchor present before restart
systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; subsequent polls show connection timeout/reset confirming node went down
Node1 exec available again with new boot ID 45f1469e-e936-4160-9ce5-2ee5d3f06fb3, differing from baseline, proving actual restart

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart - post-restart recovery of CA trust and functional TLS validation
evidence.summary: Post-restart: trust list shows CA anchor still present, openssl verify OK, and curl again validated leaf cert TLS chain with 'SSL certificate verify ok', confirming full recovery
